title: Backrooms 71
description: Backrooms 71 is a passion project consisting of the first 71 levels of the Backrooms. Most detailed and expansive Backrooms map you'll likely ever see!
body:
Backrooms 71 is passion project of mine that won't be completly finished for a LONG time due to absolute colossal scale I plan for this map to be. It will consist of the first 71 levels of the backrooms. With over 300 straight hours of work put into this, this will be a peak walking simulator. 

![Me dancing in The Complex with my mascot Steev](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/035ea78dd7dc2de10bbd1b9613f2139b0666db68.png)

## **Background**
I started working on this project on Decmeber 2025 because ever since I saw the announcment of the Backrooms movie back in August, it sparked up my intrest in the backrooms yet again. I have been a big fan of the backrooms ever since that infamous 4chan post in 2019, and Ive been playing minecraft since 2016. Since I'm already good at building, I thought, why not combine the two? And so I built, and built, and built, and still am to this day, and will not stop until all 71 levels are finished. No matter how long it takes, however many more years. 

## **Avaliable Levels**

- The Complex - Level 0
- The Habitable Zone - Level 1
- Light Out - Level 6
- The Matrix - Level 12
- Kitties House - Level 974 [Bonus Level]
- Level 9223372036854775807 [Bonus Level]

## **Levels Coming Soon**

- Sublimity - Level 37 [AKA Poolrooms]
